app.name: NEXORA
app.companyUnavailable: Sign in and select a company you can access.

workspaces.title: Manage your company workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Organize operations, members and accounting records in isolated workspaces.

login.title: Sign in to begin
login.body: Sign in with an email code or register a new account.

create.title: Create a workspace
create.subtitle: Give a company its own ledger, with members and records kept separate.
create.personalHint: For personal bookkeeping only; not part of company collaboration.
create.namePlaceholder: For example: Huaxin Trading Co., Ltd.
create.hint: Initial ledger region: Mainland China · Base currency: CNY

join.title: Join an invited workspace
join.subtitle: Use the one-time invitation code provided by the inviter.

overview.title: Workspace overview
overview.empty: Select a workspace to view its overview.

invitation.title: Join workspace
invitation.missing: Open the link in your invitation email.
invitation.useInvitedEmail: Sign in or register with the email address that received the invitation.

status.loadFailed: Workspaces are temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
status.createConflict: Creation conflict. Each account can have only one personal workspace; refresh the list to check.
status.createAmbiguous: The result could not be confirmed. Retry manually with the same name and type to reuse the operation id.
status.projectionPending: The report projection is still processing. Use Refresh projection shortly.
status.projectionUnavailable: Reports are temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
status.invitationFailed: The invitation could not be redeemed or confirmed. The workspace list was refreshed; verify the verified sign-in email. Expired or used invitations cannot be redeemed again.
status.logoutFailed: Sign-out could not be started. Please try again.

version.title: Update available
version.body: Version {version} has been released. Reload to use the latest interface.

runtime.title: System status
runtime.draftHint: What you entered on this page is kept and restored automatically.

starting.title: Starting up
starting.body: Services are starting. This page resumes automatically when ready.

updating.title: Updating
updating.body: A new release is being deployed and the system is briefly unavailable.

maintenance.title: Under maintenance
maintenance.body: The system is under maintenance. Please try again shortly.

pwa.installBody: Open in its own window and keep a readable app shell while offline.
